issue.title: sase_git_commit blocks in agent-hood rendering after pushing the commit
issue.description: REPRODUCTION: During the post-completion finalizer for commit 5b4d5b3c6 on 2026-08-15, sase_git_commit -M .sase/commit_message.md printed the before-commit hook, reported create_commit completed successfully, warned that prompt archive publication was skipped because raw_xprompt.md was unavailable, and pushed the commit: git status was clean and HEAD matched origin/master at 5b4d5b3c6. The wrapper then stayed alive for several minutes in post-commit tracking while holding /home/bryan/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/agents/.git/sase-agents-sync.lock. ps showed the process in D state with WCHAN folio_wait_bit_common, and Ctrl-C produced a traceback through run_agent_publication_step -> publish_committed_agent_hood -> _publish_queued_locked -> publish_queued_transaction -> _prepare_publications -> hooks.publish_hood -> render_browsing_payload -> render_agent_page -> render_neighbors_section -> relative_page_url -> posixpath.relpath. IMPACT: the VCS commit and push are complete, but the finalizer has to interrupt the wrapper, leaving the commit workflow with exit 130 and no normal cleanup of the temporary message file. SCOPE: investigate and bound/fix agent-hood publication rendering after the primary commit, preserving durable retry and clean commit semantics. This is not the dismissed_bundles/registry scan fixed by closed task sase-cl; the observed stack is in agent page neighbor rendering.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-cl — earlier commit-publication hang after a successful push was fixed around dismissed_bundles/agent-registry scanning; this recurrence has the same finalizer impact but a different observed stack in agent-hood neighbor rendering.

RELATED: sase-mb — current ready task covers a CI wall-clock bound on large publication-queue draining; this task is about a live finalizer stall after the push, in the same publication area but with a different user-visible failure and stack.

CLOSEOUT sase-mi.7: post-push agent-hood publication drain is bounded by _bounded_publication_drain in src/sase/agents_sync/commit_publication.py after durable outbox enqueue; a stalled render returns queued/error, keeps the request for retry, and releases the agents sync lock. Verified tests/agents_sync (including test_commit_publication_bounded_drain.py) plus tests/llm_provider/test_commit_finalizer_bead_publication.py: 287 passed.

Fixed by epic sase-mi phase 6 (commit 392dcc962). publish_committed_agent_hood in src/sase/agents_sync/commit_publication.py now runs the synchronous drain inside _bounded_publication_drain, a SIGALRM itimer bounded by SASE_AGENTS_PUBLICATION_DRAIN_TIMEOUT (default 120s). The alarm unwinds the same call stack that is already inside bounded_agents_lock's with block, so that existing finally releases sase-agents-sync.lock -- no untracked thread and no abandoned process is left able to mutate the sidecar after the lock is gone, which was the explicit constraint on this fix. A stall is routed through _record_failure, so the request stays in the durable outbox for sase agent sync to retry, the already-pushed primary commit is untouched, and incomplete work is never acknowledged; fast publication and quarantine/retirement semantics are unchanged. The bound is skipped rather than faked when SIGALRM is unavailable or the caller is not the main thread; the commit workflow reaching this path (workflows/commit/workflow_publication.py) runs on the CLI main thread. Verified by the landing agent at HEAD daf933aa5: tests/agents_sync/test_commit_publication_bounded_drain.py covers a blocked render staying bounded with the request retained and a later drain retrying successfully, and the full tests/agents_sync suite plus tests/llm_provider/test_commit_finalizer_bead_publication.py are green in a 381-test focused batch; the phase-5 large-backlog node still passes, so the new boundary reintroduced no per-request or per-hood work.
